content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `loadUserTypes` method not handling the case where the collection of user-defined types (UDTs) was empty. This oversight led to an attempt to process an empty collection, which could result in unexpected behavior or errors when loading keyspaces that contained no user types. The patch introduced a check to return early if the collection is empty, thus preventing any further processing in such cases.
